title: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 — Days 1–4 review and the Day-5 final day

research_window.note: Every value below was read inside this window and carries its own source link. Nothing is carried over from a previous session unverified.

policy: No Hotspawn '% picked', community vote or crowd participation enters any number.
No roster, rest, travel or momentum premium is added to any probability. Those factors are discussed in words only, never as a numerical adjustment.
A fixture with no compliant two-sided external book stays blank and visible; it is never filled with a default 50/50.
Aggregator-reported prices (a news or tips site quoting odds) are published as dated context and never overwrite an automated first-party estimate.
Every claim is attributed. Where a source is a wiki or a news aggregator rather than the organizer, that is stated on the row.

day_read.headline: The upset: 9z beat Aurora 2-0.
day_read.reading: Aurora, ranked sixth on HLTV at the time of the event week, lost its opening series to 9z and was pushed straight into an elimination match. The other three openers went to the higher-ranked side. FURIA beat BETBOOM 2-0 in the only group match that later became a final-day rematch.

sources.detail: HLTV's report on the opening upset, naming luchov's 1.61 rating and the +62 VRS points for 9z.

day_read.headline: Aurora stabilised; 9z took Falcons to three maps.
day_read.reading: Aurora won its elimination match 2-0 against Ninjas in Pyjamas. 9z lost 1-2 to Falcons after winning map two, so the Day-1 result did not repeat and Falcons took the group's top seed. BETBOOM and FURIA both won their group-B matches 2-1.

sources.detail: Series lines for 2399408, 2399409, 2399410 and 2399411 as published by HLTV.

day_read.headline: Aurora reversed the Day-1 result; BETBOOM survived.
day_read.reading: In the group-A decider Aurora beat 9z 2-0, so the Day-1 upset did not convert into a playoff place for 9z. In group B, BETBOOM beat Legacy 2-1 after losing the first map.

sources.detail: HLTV's report on Aurora's 2-0 rematch win over 9z securing a playoff spot.

day_read.headline: Both favourites lost. BETBOOM's reverse sweep was the bigger upset.
day_read.reading: FURIA beat Aurora 2-0 (Dust2 13-8, Inferno 13-10) to reach the grand final. BETBOOM then beat Falcons 2-1 after losing map one (Anubis 5-13, Dust2 16-14 in overtime, Mirage 13-7), ending the tournament for the higher-ranked Falcons. The two teams left in the final have already met at this event: FURIA won that group match 2-0.

sources.detail: HLTV's report: 'BETBOOM reverse-swept Falcons ... (5-13 Anubis, 16-14 Dust2, 13-7 Mirage)'.

contrarian_rules: Take the favourite by default. A contrarian pick is an exception that must earn its place, never a style.

Only take an underdog when an external two-sided book prices it at 30% or more. Below that the expected points cost outweighs the leaderboard gain — at the observed Pinnacle price BETBOOM sits at 29.3%, just under the screen, so the rule returns FURIA.

Require a verified structural story: a recent roster change with an onboarding period already served, a demonstrated map-pool edge, or a rested side against a side that just played a long series. 'They look due' is not a story.
Never convert the story into a number. Roster, rest and momentum are discussed in words; no probability on this site is adjusted by them.
Do not chase an upset in a third-place or consolation match. The points at stake are smaller and both sides have just lost.
If the only available line is a very wide book, treat it as unresolved. A 0.20/0.84 market is a spread, not a price.

upset_candidates.case_for: Ranked #14 against #4 on HLTV's analytics at observation time; arrived at the final by beating PARIVISION, Legacy and then reverse-sweeping Falcons after dropping map one. HLTV's own semifinal report notes this is Boombl4's first grand final at an MVP-eligible event since PGL Major Antwerp 2022.
upset_candidates.case_against: Lost the group-stage meeting 2-0 to FURIA and lost both meetings in the last 30 days. Played a three-map overtime semifinal on 17 October while FURIA's semifinal was a straight 2-0.
upset_candidates.verdict: The only final-day underdog with a verified structural story — and at the observed Pinnacle price it still fails the screen. Pinnacle prices BETBOOM at 29.3% against the 30% threshold in rule 2, so the screen says take FURIA. If the line drifts to 30% or better before lock the upset becomes playable; at 29.3% it is a near-miss, not a pick.

rest_and_onboarding.note: Requested by the brief as a possible upset trigger. Recorded honestly as unquantified.
observations: BETBOOM's semifinal went three maps with an overtime second map on 17 October; FURIA's was a 2-0. Any fatigue effect therefore points against BETBOOM, the side an upset pick would need.
Aurora and Falcons both played on 17 October and both lost, so neither has a rest advantage in the third-place decider.
rest_and_onboarding.limitation: No source was found that quantifies a rest, travel or onboarding effect for CS2. Nothing on this site adds such an adjustment to a probability; it is published as a consideration only.

limitations: The Pinnacle prices were read at 2026-10-18T01:37:58Z. They are a single book at a single moment, not a consensus and not a guaranteed probability; the four-hour pipeline re-reads the board and the page shows the observation time next to every price.

Pinnacle boards the Thunderpick World Championship but not the six low-tier competitions the research ladder leaves blank, so it does not close those gaps. It is an additional first-party source for the final day, not a universal fix.

Cross-book check: an independent re-read of both Polymarket series pages by another session at 2026-10-18T00:42Z produced 39.6%/60.4% for Aurora vs Falcons and 71.3%/28.7% for FURIA vs BETBOOM, against the Pinnacle board's 39.7%/60.3% and 70.7%/29.3% read at 01:37Z. The two first-party books agree to within 0.7 points on both fixtures, which is why the BETBOOM near-miss under the 30% screen is reported as a near-miss rather than rounded up.
No first-party bookmaker price was obtainable from this session's environment for either final-day fixture. The aggregator quotes above are dated news-page observations and are labelled as such.
